scope: Working-tree evidence for non-reusable inspection of body and bounded direct simple-cell merge fields. All table coverage, other owners, destination behavior and plan reuse remain explicitly unknown.
provenance: Three synthetic DOCX inputs were independently authored using the MIT fixture helper without wordnet serialization. Two generations were byte-identical. Open XML SDK 3.5.1 validated all three inputs and the actual merged output. Python independently read source and output XML and compared predictions with failed and successful merge outcomes; names in explicit probe observations are synthetic and absent from default report JSON.

negativeControls.changed source field: Simple source field or owner structure changed
negativeControls.missing requirement: Inspected body and cell requirements differ from source XML
negativeControls.wrong prediction: Missing cell-path prediction differs from the source
negativeControls.reused inspection: Inspection reuse or observed merge outcome changed
negativeControls.wrong saved cell text: Successful merge did not produce the expected independent XML text
negativeControls.leaked default path: Default output disclosed a path or claimed reuse
negativeControls.fabricated merged requirement: An unsupported table owner was treated as inspected

result.controlMethod: Parsed source/output observations changed in memory.

retainedFailures.result: Failed analyzer CA1861 for a constant array in a test assertion. The test was rewritten using collection assertions, and the focused suite passed without suppressions.
